# Security-sensitive paths (BR5.2). A pull request that changes any path below needs an
# independent security review recorded in docs/security-reviews/ for its exact patch
# identity (see scripts/check_security_review.py). The check reads this list from the base
# branch, so a pull request cannot narrow the list that judges it.
#
# Pattern rules: a pattern ending in "/" covers the whole directory; "*" matches within one
# path segment, "**/" matches any number of directories, and a pattern also covers everything
# below a directory it matches.
#
# Authentication and the local-issuer refusal (BR1.1, BR1.3).
backend/portfolio_api/settings.py
backend/portfolio_api/auth.py
# Publication boundary: routes, C2 allow-list, publish transaction, output folder (BR3.x).
backend/portfolio_api/slice/
# Rendering and escaping of public pages, and the Studio's sign-in and API client.
web/slice-renderer/
web/slice-studio/src/
# Local stack headers, exposure and the fake identity provider (BR1.2, NFR1.2, NFR15.1).
local/nginx.conf
local/compose.yaml
local/fake-idp/
# Contracts, CI, the checks themselves and infrastructure.
contracts/
.github/
scripts/
infra/
# Dependencies and their reviewed exceptions (security re-review S0-3): every pinned lock and
# its input, the npm locks, the audit ignore file and the back-end package definition.
.pip-audit-ignore
backend/pyproject.toml
**/requirements*.in
**/requirements*.lock
**/package-lock.json
# The local stack's configuration and images, the public-output scan's trusted digests and
# the end-to-end check (S0-3). local/fake-idp/Dockerfile is covered by local/fake-idp/ above.
local/compose.env
local/compose.verify.yaml
local/fixtures/derivatives.sha256.json
local/slice_check.py
local/*.Dockerfile
local/*.Dockerfile.dockerignore
local/fake-idp/Dockerfile
# The tests that guard the authentication, approval and privacy invariants (S0-3).
backend/tests/
backend/portfolio_studio/
web/local-studio/src/
